name: rank_signal_20260918_v1
checkpoint_change: User confirmed existing rounds 5/15/30; 10/20 not saved in core run
client_selection: smallest numeric client ID for each assigned capacity 6/8/12, fixed within seed
sample_split: stable source-ID hash, identical across saved rounds and factors
optimizer: same fresh AdamW as core per local call, LR .001, weight decay .01, one step
training_mode: dropout enabled during update, same seed across rank candidates; scoring/evaluation model.eval
gain: mean of per-example before minus after cross entropy; float64 loss from float32 logits
regret: oracle top4 mean single-rank gain minus score top4 mean single-rank gain; not joint four-rank update
random_reference: fixed random ranking plus exact expectation across uniformly selected 4 of 16 ranks
score_stability: Spearman and top4 Jaccard across 3 scoring batches; across consecutive SAVED states 5/15 and 15/30
scaling: A row times c; B column divided by c; c cycles 1/4,1/2,2,4 by layer/rank, shared across Q/V
shared_gate: absolute value of signed Q/V contribution derivatives summed before abs
raw_score_scope: fresh raw scores; deployed selector also contains EMA, exploration and freshness terms
aggregation: each seed averages its units equally; 7/13 and 21/42/87 reported separately; no automated score selection
undefined_correlations: null with constant-score or constant-gain reason; never filled with zero
